title: Looks good
text: Looks good. Fast delivery, didn't need to assemble it, it came in very well packaged so nothing wrong with it, my only concern is the size of it I actually wanted it to be big at first but when I saw how big it really is in comparison and in person I am a little worried now that it will fit in the small space I was planning on putting it on. But I think it will and looks okay, the opening is a little big in my opinion for this though so I just hope it keeps the magazines and papers inside and they don't fall over hopefully...
